result:
Admins can now rename their team from the profile page. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of this has been checked.

- **API:** `features/teams/api/update-team.ts` sends `PATCH /teams/{teamId}` with `{ name }` and validates the name with Zod. On success it refreshes the teams list and shows a "Team Updated" notification. The notification is in the mutation hook because `docs/api-layer.md` says components never call `useNotifications`.
- **Components:**
  - `features/teams/components/team-section.tsx` shows the current user's team name, looked up from the teams list by their `teamId`.
  - `features/teams/components/update-team.tsx` is the Rename button and form drawer. The button only renders for admins.
- **Profile page:** `app/routes/app/profile.tsx` renders the new Team section below the user information. The page imports from the teams feature, so no feature imports another.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH /teams/:teamId` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts`. It requires an admin and only allows renaming the admin's own team.

I didn't add tests for the new code.
